risk_window_review.observation: Six new punctuation-only segments appear in a gap without published dialogue. This is an observable output-quality regression; lack of subtitles alone is not a listening-based proof of silence.
The original 15-line unsupported dialogue burst is absent. Current output includes hushing and the beginning of the next genuine subtitle-covered exchange, rather than that invented-looking exchange.
The two main dialogue cues remain. There is no long fixed-temperature hush loop; the goodnight line has a name error.
The character-name call remains misrecognized as an urging phrase; this was also wrong in the earlier arms.
The failure admission and following reassurance remain. The place/character-name sentence is merged and the personal name is split into ordinary tokens.
No current segments occupy the earlier ellipsis interval; the original punctuation-only sequence stays absent.
Sustained late vocal text is retained. Its presence is not exact lyric correctness: the first-verse question is truncated and later chorus wording differs from the published score and prior outputs.

late_singing.independent_reference_check: Opened the composer-published score; it supports the existence and written structure of the song. It is not a timed acoustic annotation of this particular media file.
late_singing.first_verse_observation: Current output stops the comparison question mid-clause. Original baseline retained both contrasting objects; rejected2-second output changed the latter object. This is reference/output evidence, not a new listening judgment.
late_singing.copyright_note: No complete lyrics copied into this review; full model output remains in the existing hashed raw reports.

raw_failure_preservation: All baseline, rejected and current raw report bytes remain unchanged; hashes bind this review. Every current segment was independently matched to raw decoder text/times, saved JSON, and a read-only SQLite record.

decision.reason: The ablation restores both missing commands and retains the original four anchors, but introduces clear action/name losses, leaves ad-lib corruption, emits new punctuation-only output, and does not establish faithful sung or complete dialogue transcription.
